name: create a gtm pack that reuses pm

inputs.name: gtm
inputs.summary: Go-to-market: launch briefs and customer announcements
inputs.purpose: Turn shipped features into launch briefs for sales and announcements for custodians and banks

modes.name: launch-brief
modes.purpose: One-page brief for sales from a PRD and release notes

acceptance: depends on pm instead of copying its skills
each mode built by a child task

expect: staged gtm/pack.yaml lists pm in depends and cites pm:cite-customer-claims rather than copying it
two forge/new-mode children, each with into set to the staged gtm pack
lint and `pmos pack add … --dry-run` pass on the staged pack
one sync_pack action targeting packs/gtm; packs/ unchanged until approval
